overview_description.description: Subol develops a gas leakage detection and shutoff system designed to identify leaks and prevent hazardous situations. The company’s solution includes remote control and alarm notifications, a secure connection module, and integration with third-party home automation systems. Featuring a clip-on regulator powered by long-lasting batteries, the system enables users to effectively mitigate gas leakage risks and enhance overall safety.
